Text: “Permanent weapon is E-web Blaster (may target a character, landed starfighter, or vehicle for free; if targeting a starfighter or vehicle, add one destiny to attrition; otherwise, subtract 3 from target's immunity to attrition (if any) until end of turn).” '''What changed:''' before release: “a character, vehicle, or landed starfighter” became “a character, landed starfighter, or vehicle”; “if targeting a vehicle or starfighter” became “if targeting a starfighter or vehicle”; re-rendered with sharper graphics.
